User Story

 

As a system user

I do not want to have a possibility to edit an object in the system which is connected to another object

So that I will not make any changes in the concluded processes

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. In the system new permission for each locked object should be added with the name - 'Edit Locked Permission'

  2. If user has edit locked permission, it means that for her/him it is possible to edit objects versions which are locked in the system

    1. For example, if Product's version is added to the Product contract, it will be possible to edit only the mentioned version of the product with the edit locked permission

    2. If user does not have edit locked permission, it is not possible to edit already locked objects version

    3. System should display an error message: ‘You can't edit Product because it is connected to the Product Contract’

  3. It is possible to create a new version of the object, while another version of the same object is connected to another object in the system

    1. For example, if product has two versions and only the first version is connected to the product contract, it is possible to create its third or fourth versions

  4. Object should be locked If connected to contract/order (all statuses of contract/service will be checked, even if status is cancelled or refused)

Object

Connection to Contract/Order

Allowed operations when object is locked

Customer version

  • Service contract version

  • Service order

Edit permission

  • Enables to edit customer’s versions which are not locked

  • Locked customer’s version can’t be edited

  • In frontend Edit current version button will be disabled in locked versions

Edit locked permission

  • Enables to edit locked customer version

  • Enables to create a new customer version

  • In frontend when clicking on Edit current version button will display warning message 'Are you sure you want to edit locked object'
